BiblicalUsage: Shemeber was king of Zeboiim, one of the five kings who made war with Chedorlaomer. His name is written once, in the list of the battle, beside Bera of Sodom and Birsha of Gomorrah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the kings of the plain are named so we know the battle was real. Shemeber lost, Abram won, and I hold that God gave the victory to the man who trusted Him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
